Cancel a BioNeMo job

Source: R/07-jobs.R
job_cancel.Rd

job_cancel() asks the local or Slurm backend to stop an active job and waits for the backend to report a terminal state. The default requests an orderly termination; local execution escalates if the process does not stop. force = TRUE requests immediate termination instead. A job that is already terminal is returned unchanged.

Usage

job_cancel(x, force = FALSE)

Arguments

x

A BioNeMoJob returned by an asynchronous operation or bionemo_job().

force

Whether to request immediate termination. The default first requests an orderly stop.

Value

x, updated to the backend's terminal state, invisibly.

Details

Cancellation races with normal completion. The final state may therefore be "succeeded" or "failed" if the operation finishes before cancellation is confirmed. Cancelling does not delete the run directory, logs, or outputs.

See also

Other BioNeMo job lifecycle: bionemo_job(), job_logs(), job_path(), job_result(), job_status(), job_wait()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
job <- bionemo_job(
  "/shared/workspace/.bionemor/runs/my-generation"
)
job_cancel(job)
job_status(job)

# To skip orderly termination, use this instead on an active job:
# job_cancel(job, force = TRUE)
} # }
